rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXXV Of the mutuall Love and Concord betwixt Man and Wife
rules.historical_meaning_only: Source is specifically marital concord, separate from number-of-wives, character and childbirth. Historical sex-coded man/wife outcomes, not current couple measurements.
Lilly begins with planets previously used as signifiers of number of wives, carrying forward uncertain source interpretations.
Benefic nature of marriage signifiers forms a separate qualifier for concord testimony.
Good aspects to Moon by eligible benefics are the source's favorable branch, not simply benefics anywhere.
The source claims affection within marriage from eligible benefic-friendly contact, without actual observed couples.
Historically asserted pleasant companionship is a different subjective outcome from marriage occurring or staying married.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: perpetual good will shall continually be between them
rules.historical_meaning_only: Source asserts durable affection over time rather than a one-day observation; no follow-up.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: But if they be malevolent by nature
rules.historical_meaning_only: Malefic source begins with planet nature, not immediately with any opposing aspect.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: and have Square or Opposition to Moon
rules.historical_meaning_only: Historical source requires hard square/opposition to Moon to predict fights in negative case.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: fall out upon every slight occasion
rules.historical_meaning_only: Author says naturally malefic + hard Moon aspect supposedly entails repeated disagreement; unverified.
Source asserts lack of perfect accord, distinct subjective measure needing independent definition.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: benigne Planet aspect Moon with ill aspect
rules.historical_meaning_only: The source allows favorable-nature planet in a hostile aspect, separate intermediate category.
A benefic in hostile aspect is not classified as uniformly bad; Lilly claims moderate concord.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: yet in most things they will accord
rules.historical_meaning_only: Positive agreement in most domains is explicit exception to blanket negative aspect conclusion.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: malignant Planet friendly aspect unto Moon
rules.historical_meaning_only: Inverse combination: malefic by nature but friendly aspect rather than hostile.
Lilly claims limited agreement despite friendly aspect, not assured good concord.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: subject to disagree in most things
rules.historical_meaning_only: Even benefic aspect of malefic is said to tend adverse; source hierarchy qualitative and uncalibrated.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: evil aspect of Fortunes hurt but little
rules.historical_meaning_only: An explicit author mitigation compared with the malefic nature category, requiring nature×aspect interaction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: benevolent aspect of Infortunes for most part tends to ill
rules.historical_meaning_only: Second interaction caveat counters simplistic positive aspect = positive outcome.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: only hath relation to Lord seventh and Moon
rules.historical_meaning_only: Previous aspect claims restricted to Lord of seventh and Moon, not every conceivable marriage significator.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: but not to any other Significators
rules.historical_meaning_only: Lilly explicitly warns against generalizing those conditions to all marriage indicators.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: most assured means to know agreement or disagreement
rules.historical_meaning_only: Author prefers comparison of TWO complete genitures, not only single nativity.
Two persons' birth charts are required for the strongest original relation testimony.
Source admits absent data can prevent this comparison, not permission to choose guessed spouse chart.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun in Wives Geniture to be in Signe and degree Moon in Mans
rules.historical_meaning_only: Source says wife's natal Sun same exact sign AND degree as man's natal Moon is favorable; not merely same sign.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: or Moon in Wives place of Sun in Mans
rules.historical_meaning_only: Reciprocal alternative uses wife's natal Moon at man's Sun position, not same person's luminary match.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: very good Signe of unity and concord
rules.historical_meaning_only: The cross-chart exact-contact rule's alleged outcome is marital harmony without observed human partner pairs.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Significators of Marriage are in Sextile
rules.historical_meaning_only: The source's positive category includes sextile between relevant marriage indicators.
Trine is alternative aspect for supposed affection.
Predicted outcome of good aspects requires actual measured relationship concord for testing.
Hard aspect category is said to entail contrasting affection; exact aspects/orbs not calibrated.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Good Planets beholding Moon ... Sextile or Trine
rules.historical_meaning_only: Author reiterates benefic→Moon friendly aspects as alleged concord.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: or Lord seventh with Sextile or Trine
rules.historical_meaning_only: Lilly also allows benefics aspecting seventh ruler; distinguish from Moon-only preceding scope wording.
A Venus/Saturn/Mars configuration is asserted to indicate jealousy; exact source glyph and syntax preserved as ambiguous.
Alleged jealousy is private psychological/relationship claim, not verified participant data.
Venus in twelfth is used as alleged negative marriage sign, not necessarily absence of marriage.
Additional Jupiter twelfth is claimed to lower favorable marriage 'fortune'; composite condition.
Old economic/material judgment distinct from affection or sexual behavior.
Venus adverse to Moon forms separate discord branch.
Venus adverse to malefics also allegedly negative; exact disjunction must be kept.
Period ascribes intimate sexual conduct as reason; no evidence of infidelity and never a safety accusation.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Significators of Marriage in movable Signes
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mutable/movable sign placements are interpreted as unstable marriage according to source taxonomy.
Subjective stability outcome needs frozen scale and complete study cohort.
Lilly gives happiness/contentment as separate outcome from legal marriage count.
Venus movable sign is a separate source marker of alleged changeability of affections.
The source infers man's preference changes; not verified psychological status.
A different claim alleging desire for multiple partners rather than observed marriage count.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: especially if Moon or Venus in Cancer
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author supplies a qualifying sign for the mutable Venus assertion.
Capricorn appears as another special sign for source claim; original glyph needs checking.
Venus in common sign is distinct from movable condition.
The claim alleges affection toward marriage under different sign type, not person-specific confirmation.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of ascendant in common Signe
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author supplies one antecedent to nonmonogamy-type hypothesis.
Venus adverse condition must accompany ascendant-lord common sign for composite original rule.
Subjective dissatisfaction, not evidence of extra-marital affairs.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon behold Sun with a good aspect
rules.historical_meaning_only: An interrupted sentence crosses original page632 bottom to page633 upper; source keeps the cross-page completion.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: both of them in humane Signes
rules.historical_meaning_only: Lilly requires both luminaries in source-defined 'humane' sign category, not one only.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: one Fortunes aspect either or both
rules.historical_meaning_only: Extra benefic contacting one or both luminaries is required for the strong positive case.
The claimed outcome is couple agreement, not natal character diagnosis.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: aspects betwixt Sun Moon be ill
rules.historical_meaning_only: Lilly contrasts poor cross-luminary aspect in natal chart.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Infortune Square Opposition one or both
rules.historical_meaning_only: Additional malefic hard contact is required in strong negative branch.
Source uses indefinite severity and time horizon, no objective registry.
Source includes Moon waning as additional condition for purported absence of love.
Moon Mars conjunction is another necessary condition in an especially stigmatizing source hypothesis.
The Moon-Mars conjunction is further qualified by movable sign type.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Wife never truly loved him but another man
rules.historical_meaning_only: Original imputes hidden intimate motive/infidelity and is not established real-person evidence.
The Moon must RULE seventh for the next adverse marriage outcome; not Moon everywhere.
Waning Moon is reiterated as second qualifying condition, not alternative to Moon rulership.
Moon-eighth placement is an additional condition, distinct from previous Moon-Mars.
Subjective lack of satisfaction rather than marriage absence; no independent evidence.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXXVI Whether Native or Wife shall dye first
rules.historical_meaning_only: Next numbered source starts after horizontal divider on original PDF633 and concerns death-order, not marital concord.
Only following chapter opening phrase retained to witness separate chapter boundary; no mortality rules accepted in this batch.
